mapper.select: SELECT name FROM branch ORDER BY name

SELECT h.hq_outbound_no as hqOutboundNo, h.po_no as poNo, b.branch_code as branchCode, b.name as branchName, CASE WHEN h.status = 'PENDING' THEN '출고대기' WHEN h.status = 'PREPARING' THEN '준비중' WHEN h.status = 'SHIPPED' THEN '출고완료' ELSE '-' END AS status, h.handler as handler, DATE_FORMAT(h.shipped_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as outboundAt FROM hq_outbound h JOIN branch b ON h.branch_code = b.branch_code
AND b.name = #{branchName}
AND h.shipped_at >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND h.shipped_at <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
ORDER BY h.hq_outbound_no DESC

SELECT h.hq_outbound_no as hqOutboundNo, h.po_no as poNo, h.branch_code as branchCode, b.name as branchName, CASE WHEN h.status = 'PENDING' THEN '출고대기' WHEN h.status = 'PREPARING' THEN '준비중' WHEN h.status = 'SHIPPED' THEN '출고완료' ELSE '-' END AS status, h.handler as handler, DATE_FORMAT(h.shipped_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as outboundAt FROM hq_outbound h JOIN branch b ON h.branch_code = b.branch_code WHERE h.hq_outbound_no = #{value}

SELECT m.material_code AS itemCode, m.material_name AS itemName, mg.group_name AS category,
pod.requested_qty AS requestedQty, -- 발주 수량 d.qty AS confirmedQty, -- 출고 수량
COALESCE(ws.qty, 0) AS warehouseStock, -- 현재 재고 m.unit AS unit
FROM hq_outbound h
JOIN place_order p ON h.po_no = p.po_no JOIN place_order_detail pod ON p.po_id = pod.po_id
LEFT JOIN hq_outbound_detail d ON h.hq_outbound_no = d.hq_outbound_no AND pod.material_code = ( SELECT material_code FROM warehouse_stock WHERE stock_no = d.stock_no LIMIT 1 )
LEFT JOIN warehouse_stock ws ON ws.material_code = pod.material_code
JOIN material m ON pod.material_code = m.material_code LEFT JOIN material_group mg ON m.material_group_id = mg.material_group_id
WHERE h.hq_outbound_no = #{value}
